critical_code_review_comments: JerseyBackground contain-math is correct: on 390x844 screenAspect(0.462) < IMG_ASPECT(0.5625) so it constrains by width (imgW=390, imgH=693.33). Verified DOM measurement: img rect {x=-3, y=71, w=390, h=694}. Letterbox #0A2154 fills the ~75px top/bottom bands, blending seamlessly with the artwork's dark base — visually looks like a full-bleed background even though the actual artwork is letterboxed.

HERO_SPACE = max(320, round(844*0.58)) = 490px reserves enough vertical room so the CTA stack begins BELOW the baked-in golden wordmark + stars (which end around y=340). Accedi lands at y=568 with clear margin.

resizeMode='stretch' with explicit width=imgW/height=imgH is functionally equivalent to 'contain' here since imgW/imgH already preserve the intrinsic aspect ratio — a robust workaround for the RN-Web resizeMode='contain' quirks the author noted.
Nit: styles.heroSpacer (line 190, height:320) is defined but unused since the actual spacer inline-styles the height dynamically (line 70). Dead style — safe to remove.

rca_of_issue: REPORTED BUG (a) 'immagine di sfondo dovrebbe essere usata tutta' — CONFIRMED FIXED. Root cause was RN-Web's inconsistent handling of resizeMode='contain' on <Image> combined with an aggressive Ken Burns scale that pushed the image beyond viewport bounds. Fix by main agent: JerseyBackground now (1) computes contain-math manually via useWindowDimensions and IMG_ASPECT (999/1776=0.5625) yielding an explicit width/height that fits inside the viewport, (2) uses resizeMode='stretch' on that pre-sized box (so the pixel-perfect intrinsic ratio is preserved), (3) fills letterbox bands with #0A2154 matching the artwork's dark base, and (4) dampens Ken Burns to scale 1.0-1.015 with ±3-6px drift so the image never overflows. Verified with DOM measurement + visual screenshot that the whole 'MEET THE LEGEND' wordmark and 5 stars are visible with the CTAs sitting cleanly below. REPORTED BUG (b) 'non mi carica l app' — CONFIRMED FIXED (was already resolved in iter5 via Metro cache wipe). Both fixes hold across a full happy-path regression run with zero page errors.
